items.title: Servers, actions and the REST API
items.body: Create, power, rebuild, resize and delete servers. Every change returns an action you can wait on. OpenAPI spec included.

items.title: nebla CLI with releases and a Homebrew tap
items.body: The nebla CLI covers the same things as the panel, with contexts and table, JSON or YAML output.

items.title: Built-in OS template catalog
items.body: Admins enable official cloud images (Debian, Ubuntu, Rocky, Alma, Fedora) per location in one click.

items.title: Web panel: servers and one-page create
items.body: Server list and a single-page create flow with live availability and quota.

items.title: Console, graphs, rebuild, resize, labels and activity
items.body: Browser console, CPU/disk/network graphs, rebuild and resize, labels with filtering, and server and project activity.

items.title: Clear action errors
items.body: Failed actions show a plain, member-safe message. Technical detail stays admin-only.

items.title: One-line Proxmox setup
items.body: Connect a Proxmox node by running one command on it and pasting the result back.

items.title: Members, invites and API tokens
items.body: Project members with roles, invite links, and per-project API tokens shown once.

items.title: Account page with two-factor login
items.body: Change your password and turn on TOTP two-factor login.

items.title: Passkey login
items.body: Log in with a passkey and manage your passkeys from the account page. Merged; ships in v0.3.

items.title: Admin screens
items.body: Admin pages for users, projects and quotas, settings, hand-registered images and activity with technical detail. Merged; ships in v0.3.

items.title: Volumes
items.body: Extra disks you can create, attach, detach and resize, kept when a server is deleted or rebuilt. In the panel and the CLI.

items.title: Backups with Proxmox Backup Server
items.body: Daily and on-demand backups of a server's boot disk on PBS, keeping the last few, with restore in place. In the panel and the CLI.

items.title: Private networks
items.body: Private networks between a project's servers, built on Proxmox SDN.

items.title: Firewalls
items.body: User-defined firewall rules you can apply to servers, on top of today's anti-spoofing.

items.title: Panel redesign
items.body: A new design system and app shell built around the logo's arch, equally at home in light and dark. Includes an empty server list with a matching `nebla server create` example, and "Soon" entries in the nav for volumes and firewalls until their pages ship.

items.title: Live metrics on the server Overview
items.body: Live CPU, network and disk cards on a server's Overview tab.

items.title: Recent activity on the server Overview
items.body: The server's last three actions on its Overview tab.

items.title: Server list filters and CPU sparklines
items.body: Filter the server list by status (all, running, off) and see a small CPU graph on each row.

items.title: Command palette
items.body: Press ⌘K to search and jump to pages, servers, SSH keys and admin pages.

items.title: Snapshots
items.body: Save a copy of a server's boot disk and restore it later.

items.title: Floating IPs
items.body: IPs you can move between servers for failover.

items.title: Primary IP management
items.body: Keep a server's IP when it's deleted and assign it to another server later.

items.title: Go SDK
items.body: A documented, versioned Go client for the Nebla API.

items.title: Terraform provider
items.body: Manage servers, keys, networks and volumes as code. Built on the Go SDK.

items.title: OIDC / SSO login
items.body: Log in through an identity provider such as Authentik, Keycloak or any OIDC provider.

items.title: Webhooks and audit log export
items.body: Send activity events to your own endpoints and export the audit log.

items.title: Metrics alerts
items.body: Alerts on CPU, disk and network thresholds, sent by email or webhook.

items.title: Delete and rebuild protection
items.body: Lock a server so it can't be deleted or rebuilt by mistake.

items.title: Reset root password
items.body: Set a new root password on a running server through the guest agent.

items.title: Custom images
items.body: Turn a snapshot into an image and create servers from it, or upload your own qcow2.

items.title: Memory usage in server metrics
items.body: Show memory use next to CPU, disk and network in a server's graphs and Overview.

items.title: Placement rules and live migration
items.body: Smarter placement across a cluster's nodes and moving running servers between nodes.

items.title: IPv6: routed /64 per server and IPv6-only pools
items.body: Servers already get an optional IPv6 address. This adds a routed /64 per server and IPv6-only pools.

items.title: Mobile-friendly web panel
items.body: Check status and power-cycle servers from a phone.

items.title: Docs site
items.body: A real documentation site with guides and an API reference.

items.title: One-click apps
items.body: An official catalog of ready-to-run apps, such as Docker, Nextcloud and WordPress, set up on a new server through cloud-init.

items.title: OS template store
items.body: A larger, browsable catalog of OS images that admins add from the panel, extending today's built-in templates.

items.title: Rescue mode
items.body: Boot a server into a rescue system to repair a broken OS or recover files.

items.title: Mount an ISO
items.body: Attach an ISO to a server and install any OS by hand through the console.

items.title: Reverse DNS
items.body: Set PTR records for your IPs, through a DNS backend such as PowerDNS.

items.title: Placement groups
items.body: Spread a set of servers across different nodes for redundancy.

items.title: v1.0: stable API and upgrade path
items.body: A stability promise for the API and CLI, a tested upgrade path, and a security review.

items.title: Reseller module (commercial)
items.body: A paid add-on for resellers: billing integration, customer self-signup, white-label branding, usage metering, and reseller/sub-customer hierarchy. The core stays free and complete.

items.title: Load balancers and managed certificates
items.body: Load balancers in front of servers, with managed TLS certificates.

items.title: Optional node agent
items.body: An optional agent on Proxmox nodes for richer metrics, a faster console and host-level firewalling. Nebla keeps working without it.

items.title: High availability for the panel
items.body: Run more than one panel instance so the panel itself survives a failure.

items.title: Translations (i18n)
items.body: The web panel in more languages.

items.title: LXC containers
items.body: Exploring. Nebla is VMs only today.

items.title: Community apps and templates
items.body: Apps and OS templates from the community, submitted as pull requests to a reviewed nebla-cloud index. Admins choose which sources to turn on and can add their own.

items.title: Usage reports
items.body: Resource-hours per project and server, with no billing. The reseller module can build on it.

items.title: DNS zones
items.body: Host DNS zones and records from the panel.

items.title: Object storage (S3)
items.body: S3-compatible buckets, for example backed by Ceph RGW.
